> @copilot vercel 部署使用临时域名时，报跨域错误 

Added Hono CORS middleware to the outer app in `server/index.ts` (commit e95f3a9). The serverless function now returns proper `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` headers for cross-origin requests.

Allowed origins:
- All Vercel deployment URLs from env vars (`VERCEL_URL`, `VERCEL_BRANCH_URL`, `VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL`)
- Any `*.vercel.app` subdomain (covers all preview/temporary deployments)
- `localhost` for local development

The CORS middleware is placed on the outer Hono app **before** the catch-all route, so OPTIONS preflight requests are answered immediately without waiting for kernel cold-start.

> @copilot 
> The pattern "api/index.js" defined in `functions` doesn't match any Serverless Functions inside the `api` directory.

Removed the `functions` block from `vercel.json` in `399f602`. The `api/index.js` file is generated during the build step by `bundle-api.mjs`, so it doesn't exist when Vercel validates the `functions` patterns pre-build.

The function config (memory/maxDuration) is already handled by the in-code `export const config` in `server/index.ts` (line 293), which Vercel's `@vercel/node` runtime picks up from the deployed bundle without needing a vercel.json pattern match.

Also reverted the rewrite destination to `/api` (the route path auto-detected from `api/index.js`) instead of `/api/index.js` (which is a file path, not a route).

The root cause is that `VITE_SERVER_URL` was hardcoded to `https://play.objectstack.ai` in `vercel.json`, so preview deployments make cross-origin requests to the production server (which doesn't have the CORS middleware from this branch).

Fixed in `76e66ad`:
- Changed `VITE_SERVER_URL` from `"https://play.objectstack.ai"` to `""` (empty string / same-origin) — each deployment now calls its own serverless function at `/api/*` instead of the production API cross-origin
- Extracted `getVercelOrigins()` helper to keep CORS and `trustedOrigins` allowlists in sync
- CORS middleware remains as a safety net for any edge cases

> @copilot 还是不行，所有 api 都还是返回html

Found the root cause in `15073a5`. Vercel's `framework: null` defaults `outputDirectory` to `public/` when that directory exists, and it **only** detects serverless functions **inside** the output directory. The bundled `api/index.js` was at the project root (outside `public/`), so Vercel never recognised it — all `/api/*` routes fell through to the SPA catch-all.

Fixed `build-vercel.sh` to copy `api/index.js` into `public/api/` after the SPA files are placed. Vercel now detects the function within its output directory.

> @copilot+claude-opus-4.6 你不要乱改，参考这个项目是好的 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/main/vercel.json

Adopted the hotcrm deployment pattern in `a249322`:

1. Created committed `api/[[...route]].ts` catch-all route (matching hotcrm's `api/[[...route]].ts`)
2. Changed esbuild output from CJS to ESM — the `"type": "module"` in package.json causes Node.js to expect ESM in `.js` files, so the previous CJS format would fail to parse
3. Changed output path to `api/[[...route]].js` and rewrites to `/api/:path*` → `/api/[[...route]]` (matching hotcrm)
4. Removed `outputDirectory` — Vercel defaults handle `public/` for static + `api/` for functions
5. Reverted build-vercel.sh to original (no copy-to-public workaround)

Fixed in `ab6ad6a`. Vercel's `@vercel/node` builder was compiling the committed `api/[[...route]].ts` stub on its own, overwriting the self-contained esbuild bundle with a thin re-export that references `../server/index` — a file that doesn't exist at runtime.

The build script now deletes the `.ts` file after esbuild creates the bundle, so Vercel only sees the pre-bundled `.js` and uses it as-is.

Fixed in `ab6ad6a`. The `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` was caused by Vercel's `@vercel/node` builder compiling the `.ts` stub itself (overwriting the esbuild self-contained bundle). Added `rm -f "api/[[...route]].ts"` after `node scripts/bundle-api.mjs` in `build-vercel.sh` so Vercel uses the pre-bundled JS directly.
@copilot File not found: /vercel/path0/apps/studio/api/[[...route]].ts

> @copilot File not found: /vercel/path0/apps/studio/api/[[...route]].ts

Fixed in `cfc2227`. Replaced the `.ts` stub with a committed `.js` wrapper (`api/[[...route]].js`) that re-exports from a separately-named esbuild bundle (`api/_handler.js`).

This avoids the chicken-and-egg problem:
- `.ts` stub → Vercel TS-compiles it, overwrites the esbuild bundle → `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`
- Deleting `.ts` during build → `File not found`
- `.js` wrapper + separate `_handler.js` → Vercel uses the `.js` directly (no TS compilation), the file is never deleted, and it loads the self-contained bundle at runtime

Fixed in `6886a92`. Added `createRequire` banner to the esbuild config:

```js
import { createRequire } from "module";
const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
```

When esbuild converts CJS dependencies (knex/tarn) to ESM format, their `require('events')` calls go through esbuild's `__require` shim which throws "Dynamic require is not supported". The shim checks `typeof require !== "undefined"` and uses the real `require` when available — the `createRequire` banner provides that real `require` in the ESM scope.

The `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `../server/index` was from the previous approach (`.ts` stub). The `cfc2227` commit fixed that by switching to a committed `.js` wrapper + separate `_handler.js` bundle.

The follow-up "Dynamic require of events" error (from `_handler.js`) is fixed in `6886a92` with a `createRequire` banner in the esbuild config.

The studio uses esbuild bundling (instead of hotcrm's native Vercel TS compilation) because workspace packages at `../../packages/` can't be reliably resolved by Vercel's `@vercel/node` builder in a pnpm monorepo. The esbuild bundle is self-contained.

Fixed in `0fa5419`. The `includeFiles` pattern was matching nothing because `apps/studio/node_modules/better-sqlite3` doesn't exist — this monorepo uses pnpm's strict mode (no `shamefully-hoist` like hotcrm), so transitive native dependencies aren't symlinked into app-level `node_modules/`.

Added a build step in `build-vercel.sh` that copies native external modules (`better-sqlite3`, `@libsql/*`) from the monorepo root's `../../node_modules/` into the studio's local `node_modules/` using `cp -rL` (follows pnpm symlinks). The `includeFiles` pattern now finds the actual files for Vercel's function packaging.
